hook_zh: 坪和平方公尺，一張圖換算
caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本篇由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「方寸」發布，圖像為 AI 生成，並非真人。
坪、平方公尺、公分混著看，很容易算錯。
先全部換成同一種單位再比較：1 坪約 3.3 平方公尺（出處和資料日期在圖的最下面）。
這張只換算單位，不判斷任何房屋的坪數。收藏起來，要比尺寸的時候拿出來對照～
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This post is published by the AI-generated virtual character "Fangcun"; the images are AI-generated and are not a real person.
Mixing tsubo, square metres and centimetres makes errors easy.
Convert everything to one unit before comparing: 1 tsubo is about 3.3 square metres (the source and data date are at the bottom of the image).
This image only converts units and does not judge the tsubo size of any property. Save it and use it when you compare sizes~

sources.claim: 1 坪 = 400/121 平方公尺, about 3.3058 平方公尺 (RECALLED, not opened in this session). The official definition must be opened and the exact page recorded before approval; candidate publishers to look for: 內政部 or a statute on law.moj.gov.tw (not checked).
sources.url: UNVERIFIED-OPERATOR-TO-FILL (paste the exact official page URL; do not publish with this placeholder)

sources.claim: ARITHMETIC ONLY, derived from the definition above: 1 / 3.3058 = 0.3025 坪 per 平方公尺 (exactly 121/400); 12 x 0.3025 = 3.63 坪; 5 x 3.3058 = 16.529, shown as about 16.53 平方公尺. Recomputed by Claude 2026-10-12.
ARITHMETIC ONLY, no source needed: 300 公分 x 400 公分 = 120,000 平方公分; 1 平方公尺 = 100 x 100 = 10,000 平方公分; 120,000 / 10,000 = 12 平方公尺. Example numbers are 示意數字.
